_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "decks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "settings_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deck_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES decks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "front" TEXT NOT NULL, "back" TEXT NOT NULL, "hint" TEXT NULL, "card_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "media_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "latex" TEXT NULL, "occlusion_json" TEXT NULL, "source_doc_id" TEXT NULL, "source_excerpt" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "fsrs_json" TEXT NULL, "due" INTEGER NULL, "suspended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "buried_until" INTEGER NULL, "flagged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sibling_id" TEXT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "recognition_flag" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "scheduled_days" REAL NULL, "actual_days" REAL NULL, "elapsed_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "reviewed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_docs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deck_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("device_id" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_hlc" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation_jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "tokens_used" INTEGER NULL, "prompt_version" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "cards_count" INTEGER NULL, "chunk_count" INTEGER NULL, "files_json" TEXT NULL, "result_deck_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_presets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "config_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "deck_id" TEXT NULL, "prompt_versions_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation_units" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES generation_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "unit_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "section_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "topic" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "statement" TEXT NOT NULL, "salience" REAL NOT NULL, "splittable" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchors_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "unit_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation_batches" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES generation_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "batch_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "requested" INTEGER NOT NULL, "generated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "invalid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duplicates" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cause" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "batch_index"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES generation_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "batch_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_id" TEXT NULL, "angle" TEXT NULL, "card_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_card_id" TEXT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_maps" ("document_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "map_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("document_id", "content_hash"));
CREATE INDEX idx_cards_deck_due ON cards (deck_id, due)
CREATE INDEX idx_cards_hash ON cards (deck_id, content_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_card_drafts_run_hash ON card_drafts (run_id, content_hash)
